source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Click tab "Dashboard"
And also enter "Server Health" -> "Sensor Reading"

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor Reading & Threshold is human reable and match with spec.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sensor get 'PWR_PSU1~6' 2>&1; echo ---SDR-FALLBACK---; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sdr elist 2>&1 | head -100
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: returns FULL raw `ipmitool (OOB lanplus) sensor get "<SENSOR>"` reading + threshold; user judges (read-only).

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES passes `PWR_PSU1~6` as a literal sensor, so it neither proves six records nor identifies fitted slots, FRUs, AC feeds, PMBus pages, electrical boundaries or sharing state. The first-100-line fallback can omit a later PSU and its thresholds.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED correctly requires separate per-slot collection, model references and load/redundancy context. V3.1 additionally keys evidence to FRU serial and feed, handles mixed/unfitted slots, distinguishes per-PSU power from the two CRPS points, and requires total-versus-sum consistency only after boundary/window alignment.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 902/2291 treats a range-shaped string as runnable and does not audit six-slot completeness, per-model PMBus provenance, current-sharing state, UI identity or state-specific acceptance.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Wistron-BMC-00087-V003 is a separate dynamic load/protection case for the same labels and does not authorize stress here. Wistron-BMC-00192-V003 covers two CRPS-level points; those may be aggregates or different boundaries and cannot replace six slot records. The Wistron-BMC-00087 code collision with an unrelated BurnIn row is not a duplicate of this source code.

original_test_intent: Verify `PWR_PSU1` through `PWR_PSU6` are six independently identifiable PSU power telemetry points and that each fitted slot is represented correctly in Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading with the applicable FRU, feed, measured boundary, units, status and supported thresholds under the recorded sharing and load state.
original_method: Inventory all six physical slots, bind each exact sensor to a PSU FRU/serial, AC feed and PMBus page, then collect complete passive raw and UI readings separately. Compare each fitted unit to its model- and state-specific specification and document the approved behavior of unfitted or standby slots without changing load or redundancy.
manual_activity: The PSU owner confirms the fitted six-slot topology, FRU/feed mapping, mixed-model applicability and current sharing mode, then supplies per-model power acceptance. Automation may collect passive BMC/PMBus/UI evidence; a human decides N/A handling and the slot-by-slot verdict. This row does not authorize stress or PSU service.
required_inputs: Chassis/power-backplane PN/revision, BMC build and PSU1-6 versus CRPS1-2 architecture
For every slot: fitted state, FRU PN/serial/model/firmware, rated power, AC feed/PDU phase and active/standby/redundancy role
Per-sensor electrical boundary, quantity/units and PMBus bus/address/page/command/format/scaling/calibration/window
Stable SDR/API/UI identities and per-model, input-voltage- and load-dependent ranges, tolerances, thresholds/hysteresis and status rules
Expected current-sharing/hot-spare behavior plus unfitted, off, zero, unavailable, stale and fault semantics
Recorded host/GPU/system load, input voltage, feed health and cooling
Protected supported OOB/API/browser client and pinned reviewed `sensor.git` revision or approved manual method
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL, PSU, AC-feed or host power logs; prior imbalance and transient evidence is relevant.
Do not send the literal `PWR_PSU1~6` name. Enumerate six exact records and bind each to FRU serial, physical slot and feed before comparison.
Do not assume slot number equals PMBus page/order, and do not claim unfitted slots failed unless Project SPEC requires an installed unit there.
Do not equate a per-PSU input/output reading with CRPS or system aggregate power; align boundary, efficiency and sample windows before any sum or cross-check.
Do not remove/reseat a PSU, switch feeds, disable redundancy/hot-spare, change system load, thresholds, policy or firmware. Record passive sharing only.
Use secret-safe access and full inventory; do not expose `-P`, assume cipher 17, truncate output, run the inaccessible Script or automatically retry a missing/faulted PSU.
agent_execution_scope: Validate six-slot inventory/feed/FRU/PMBus/SDR/UI mapping, current sharing mode, protected access and model references; create one expectation row per physical slot.

Read every fitted or expected PSU record separately with FRU identity, boundary, value, units, threshold capability/values, status, PMBus page, integration window and timestamp; capture exact unchanged UI rows.
Record concurrent input voltage/feed health, redundancy/hot-spare mode, total and GPU/host load and cooling; compare each slot only with its applicable model/state rule.
Return complete raw/redacted evidence without log clear, load/feed/PSU/redundancy/policy/threshold/firmware change, automatic retry or DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the six-slot population, feed and CRPS relationship plus each sensor-to-FRU/page mapping and any allowed mixed-model configuration.
Provide boundary/scaling/window and per-model/state limits, sharing tolerance, threshold/status/freshness and N/A rules; approve the tool or Project Override.
Review every required slot independently and issue the formal verdict without substituting an aggregate, CRPS reading or dynamic-stress evidence.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Unfit: tilde shorthand is not a standard IPMI wildcard, so one lookup cannot establish six slot-bound readings. The truncated fallback, command-line password and fixed cipher also fail complete protected evidence, while no FRU/page/boundary or operating-state comparison is supplied.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Enumerate complete FRU and SDR/PMBus inventory, resolve six exact slot records, query them through protected read-only access and correlate synchronized raw fields with the exact UI rows and per-model/state specification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: PWR_PSU1~6, both WebUI paths, source Criteria, generic clear wording, Script, DeepSeek command and 1/0-minute values remain preserved; Review expands the range without editing Master or importing workload from another case.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a six-slot FRU/feed/page matrix, record load, voltage and sharing mode, then collect complete time-aligned PMBus/SDR and UI telemetry and apply each installed model's boundary-specific limits.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The precise six-slot power-backplane and BMC/PSU/PMBus implementation documented by the Project.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/backplane, BMC/SDR/WebUI, each PSU model/firmware, management client and Script revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project power tree and slot/feed map, PSU vendor PMBus Application Notes, approved mixed-model/redundancy policy, BMC SDR repository and WebUI schema.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Expands the shorthand to six serial-bound slots and adds feed, model, PMBus and sharing context while retaining passive display verification.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: This does not validate hot-remove/add, AC failover, current-share transients, load/derating response, overload/protection, efficiency or CRPS aggregate points.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Six-slot inventory/feed map, telemetry boundary and scaling, sharing/load state, per-model acceptance and validated collection path.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Hot-spare or mixed-rated PSUs can show intentionally unequal power; summing differently sampled or electrically different channels can create false mismatch.

project_override_considerations: Redfish/OEM or vendor PMBus telemetry may be approved as an alternative only if the original ipmitool method remains recorded and each slot's FRU/feed/page/boundary, value, units, thresholds, status and freshness coverage is equivalent. CRPS1/2, facility power or a system aggregate cannot automatically substitute for six individual PSU records.
expected_evidence: Chassis/power-backplane/BMC identity and six-slot population plus PSU-to-CRPS architecture
Per-slot FRU PN/serial/model/firmware/rating, AC feed/PDU phase, role and stable PMBus/SDR/UI identity map
Complete separate electrical-boundary value, units, page/command/scaling/window, thresholds, status and synchronized timestamp with redacted Dashboard/Server Health rows
Recorded input voltage/feed health, redundancy/hot-spare/share mode, host/GPU/system load and cooling plus per-model/state comparison and any valid total-versus-sum analysis
Explicit unfitted/standby/fault/zero/unavailable/stale disposition, protected tool provenance, no-clear/no-service-or-load-change/no-retry proof, final PSU/BMC health and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: This row's Items, passive Sensor Page navigation and readability/specification Criteria consistently target six PSU power displays. The separate Wistron-BMC-00087 code collision does not affect this unique code, and missing topology/model details are readiness inputs rather than an internal conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The six per-slot passive power-display purpose is clear. Normal Project inventory and vendor PMBus specifications can resolve population, boundary and acceptance, so the case remains review-complete with execution readiness pending rather than permanently BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes unsupported YES to PACKAGE and replaces one literal range lookup with six serial/slot/feed/page-bound checks.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on classification and adds mixed-model/hot-spare handling, serial and AC-feed identity, current-sharing context and explicit separation from CRPS aggregate points.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces command-existence reasoning with complete six-slot raw/UI/model/state evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps dynamic load/protection and CRPS display coverage separate, so neither is silently credited here.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: The related dynamic draft is historical context only; no invalid draft of this exact case exists.

review_improvement: Prevents an invalid range, slot/page swap, absent-slot misclassification, input/output mismatch or legitimate hot-spare imbalance from masquerading as six-PSU coverage, while preventing a passive UI row from triggering PSU or load changes.
independent_technical_reasoning: Per-PSU power depends on FRU model, AC input, rated capacity, sharing or hot-spare mode and whether the reported quantity is input or output. Numeric slot order is not enough because PMBus page and physical position may diverge. Complete serial/feed mapping and synchronized operating context are therefore required before the six values can be judged or summed.
